{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that we now have one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f"Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}"

# Check assay_batch: batch B is in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
# Apply correction only to batch B
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
